title: Ambiguous-case pilot selection rule
population: Broad Genuinely Ambiguous / Unclassified Large Load research pool
selection_principle: Select a small methodological pilot that maximizes closure diversity and reproducibility rather than raw site count.
mandatory_admission_gate: A case must independently pass the strict load-classification gate before it can be treated as a load-discovery case.
eligibility: initial_registry_classification == Genuinely Ambiguous / Unclassified Large Load
stable queue/load record available for the candidate
candidate is large enough to remain inside the registry's declared research threshold or source universe
retained source explicitly classifies the underlying request as Load/new load/increase load or equivalent
candidate is not a Generation, Surplus, Transmission, Replacement, or Upgrade record unless an explicit load component is separately established
coverage_dimensions: deliberate inconclusive outcome and stopping rule
selection_note: The 141-row pool is a broad research pool, not 141 confirmed discoveries. The three-case pilot is intentionally not presented as a representative sample; it is a methodological test set designed to demonstrate both successful adjudication and honest non-closure.
